scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @usmle/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,bff,web "npm run dev -w @usmle/shared" "npm run dev -w @usmle/api" "npm run dev -w @usmle/bff" "npm run dev -w @usmle/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @usmle/shared && npm run build -w @usmle/api && npm run build -w @usmle/bff && npm run build -w @usmle/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @usmle/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @usmle/shared && vitest run
scripts.dev:servers: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @usmle/shared && concurrently -k -n api,bff "npm run dev -w @usmle/api" "npm run dev -w @usmle/bff"
scripts.check: npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @usmle/shared && vitest run tests/integration
